Leo does NOT stand fully; keep his trunk, hip, hind legs and tail resting. Front paws rest in a clear neutral position; no blocking paw planted yet. Milo is on Leo's screen-RIGHT at the nose/front-paw side, newly on the path, upright/ground-supported, facing screen-left and looking slightly up toward Leo, alarmed but not smiling. No jumping, no touching/standing on Leo, and no paw grabbing or trapping Milo. Both occupy compatible same-depth support; make contact surfaces readable for later composition. Milo upright projected head fraction target is 0.39 +/-0.01 only in comparable head pitch; bent/raised projections must use view-compatible surface guides. Leo retains canonical face/mane/ear/trunk/paw construction and his own horizontal/vertical ratios, never Milo's targets. Stable rounded clawless paws, no extra limbs or disconnected thighs. Soft neutral light, genuine transparent alpha, no cast shadows, props, captions, annotation marks or watermark. Closed toothless still mouths. This is path-arrival phase S06-L001-B02-I02 only, not the whole action sequence.
